body.x: ImageNEXT(www.imagenext.co.kr) grabbed the attention from the European market with its flagship device, "OmniPAD," in Mobile World Congress(MWC) 2015.

After first introducing itself in the global stage at CES 2015 in Las Vegas, it went to Europe by participating in MWC 2015. The Minister of Economy of France and the head of Industrial Renewal and Information Technology made personal visits to ImageNEXT's booth at CES 2015 and was especially fascinated by OmniPAD.

Android-based OmniPAD is an all-in-one combination tablet PC which provides Around View Monitoring(AVM) system, navigation, and blackbox when it is installed in a vehicle. This is a completely new type of tablet PC which the use can be transformed between a PC and an automobile monitoring system, depending on the needs.
The greatest feature of this device is that if four cameras are added to the vehicle, it becomes an 360˚ AVM system, OmniVUE, also developed by ImageNEXT.
OmniPAD has a highly precise auto-calibration which shortens the time of installation and adds convenience.
Starting with Lane Departure Warning System, it will be able to support Forward Collision Warning System, Moving Object Detection, and other next generation ADAS in the future.
AVM of ImageNEXT has been approved for its quality, and has OEM agreements with major automobile companies like Renault Samsung.

The launching of OmniPAD meant that it would serve as a new growth power centered on automotive industries in stagnant Tablet PC market, and it would be the basic ECU system of automotive in connected car market in the future.
OmniPAD that was displayed in MWC 2015 has been improved from CES 2015.

Mr. Wonin Baek, the President & CEO of ImageNEXT, said, "Through lauching OmniPAD in MWC 2015, ImageNEXT will target the European market, and we will not stop developing and leading the IT technology of automotive," conveying the significance of OmniPAD's participation in MWC 2015.

Aside from OmniPAD, ImageNEXT is also going to exhibit Fleet Management, the smart control system which is a combination of Telematics technology and cloud service and provides effective vehicle control system together with management service to increase the efficiency of the work.

Over the years, Mobile World Congress(MWC) had built itself as one of the landmark shows of the leading technologies, products, and services that are shaping the future of the mobile industry. The major topics for this year's MWC will be big data, connecting the underserved digital societies, emerging devices, enterprise mobility, financial inclusion, the future of networks, HetNets/small cells, the Internet of Things, LTE-Advanced and 5G, mobile commerce, mobile identity, and privacy and security.

AVING News is providing an on-site coverage on MWC 2015 to deliver the fastest and freshest news on mobile technology. In March, AVING News will be hosting and organizing a review conference, "MWC 2015 Review & Face to Face Conference."
